headline: Kalyani Forge Company Secretary Anup Sancheti resigns
summary: Kalyani Forge Limited has announced the resignation of Mr. Anup Dilip Sancheti from his role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The resignation is effective from September 30, 2026. The company has notified the NSE regarding this leadership change.
whats_next: Appointment of a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
why_it_matters: Routine leadership change with no immediate impact on stock performance.
